title.narrative: Collective Responsibility, Action and Accountability for Improved Nutrition

description.narrative: To address maternal and child under nutrition fully, the Action will establish an innovative, resilient and scalable local level pro-poor Nutrition Governance model by adopting an integrated, comprehensive and multi-sectoral approach to improve nutrition. The action takes a system strengthening approach by improving capacity of communities, private sector, Government and civil society to improve access and up-take of quality nutrition services for women and children. The action will reach out to 482,820 final beneficiaries. The action will be implemented by a Coastal Consortium and all the partners have extensive experience of working on coastal areas including nutrition and agriculture interventions, system strengthening and governance, WASH and SBCC, and extensive experience of working with the government. Interventions will focus on better hygiene practices, developing effective linkages between targeted HHs and private sectors, training government officials and establishing a Civil Society Organisation (CSO) platform.
